fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/orofino-campground-and-picnic-area ('No fees are required for this site. There is no fee ($0) for the campground or pavilion.'; page last updated August 31, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service recommends trailers not exceed 22 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/orofino-campground-and-picnic-area ('There are 10 camping units available, with a recommendation that trailers do not exceed 22 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/orofino-campground-and-picnic-area ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'This site is open seasonally from late June through mid-September, dependent on weather.' The same page also says it is 'open year round and accessible from late May through mid-November, dependent on weather.'

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/orofino-campground-and-picnic-area ('Reservations: First come-first served.', 'do not exceed the 16-day camping limit'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Pintler RD) campground and picnic area ~13 mi SE of Deer Lodge on FS Road 82; first-come pavilion. No garbage service: pack out what you pack in. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Pintler RD), free, first-come. Confirmed $0, 10 units with a 22-ft trailer recommendation, vault toilets, potable water, FCFS, seasonal; added 16-day limit and the season wording (late June - mid September). Hookups left as recorded (derived none; the page says nothing about hookups). Note trimmed of restated values and the unconfirmed 'hand-pump'.
